checks.sources_say: Email attachments: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf; mailroom confirms all three received (unopenable, counted as received); all are attached to the claim of policyholder Yanis Moreau, policy VER-1006, vehicle Dacia Sandero (2022). Contract Article 4.3 requires for C2: photos of the damage, repair quote, accident report signed by both drivers when a third party is involved; email states the report was signed
checks.evidence: Customer email attachment list; mailroom note 'count as received'; contract.pdf Article 4.3 required-documents table (2630#10414, page 2); file contents not openable per mailroom instruction, so belonging to this policyholder/vehicle is taken from the email context, not the files themselves

checks.sources_say: Nothing in the email or documents indicates any Article 3 exclusion: no alcohol/drugs, the policyholder holds a licence (licence_date 2025-01-15), no racing/track use, damage not intentional by the policyholder (the other driver admitted fault), and the damage is collision damage, not wear/mechanical failure
checks.evidence: Customer email (no exclusion facts stated); contract.pdf Article 3 exclusions list (2630#10414, page 2); Policy Schedule licence_date 2025-01-15

verdict.summary: All recorded facts match the email and contract except third_party_identified, which the email contradicts (the third party Ms. Nguyen is named and signed the report), so the claim is payable under C2 within the deadline with no exclusion and no playbook referral, but the not-at-fault deductible waiver in Article 5.2 appears to have been missed, affecting the staged deductible/payout amounts.
